projects.title: Aside AI
projects.description: Aside AI is a Raspberry Pi wearable with a camera and mic that narrates a room in real time using swappable personalities. Helped build the pipeline between the hardware and software. This meant I helped resolve issues with the computer vision, Python translation system, the microcomputer structure, and the external design. Built at the UC Berkeley AI Hackathon.We Also Won Deepgram sponsor prize. During the hackathon alone brought in 20k views and 100 follows organically across different social media platforms to promote the product.

projects.title: Recco
projects.description: Recco is a camera first AI networking assistant. Point your phone at a room and it recognizes the people in frame, surfacing each person's role, what they build, and a one line reason to talk to them. You can filter the crowd by voice ("show me AI founders") and draft a warm, personalized opener in one tap

projects.title: SafeHaven
projects.description: A privacy first crisis support platform for domestic violence survivors, disguised as everyday utility apps (calculator, news reader, weather) so it stays invisible on a monitored phone. Behind the disguise, it offers encrypted evidence journaling, one-tap SOS alerts with location to trusted contacts, real-time friend-gated messaging, and 24/7 trauma-informed AI support.

projects.title: dAdvisor
projects.description: A web app that helps UC Davis undergraduates plan a major change. Students pick their current and target majors, check off completed courses, assign remaining requirements to quarters, and get an estimate of the courses, units, and time left to graduate in the new major.

projects.title: Semi-autonomous Rover
projects.description: Developed 10+ semi-autonomous Rovers in collaboration with the Engineering Club. These Rovers featured object detection by integrating C++ with hardware sensors for a community college STEM Day, an initiative designed to showcase engineering possibilities to high school students. Which I helped organize by facilitating outreach for 200+ first-generation students.

projects.title: Dprotein
projects.description: DProtein is a full stack web app that helps UC Davis students find high protein dining options nearby, ranking dining hall menu items by distance and protein content with live route guidance, favorites, and a day/meal availability tracker. Built with a FastAPI + PostgreSQL backend on Railway and a React + TypeScript + Tailwind frontend on Vercel.(Might be out of credits so API is not working)

projects.title: Yoga Pose Corrector
projects.description: A computer vision app that classifies yoga poses and gives real time form correction

projects.title: Zeno (Tier Zero)
projects.description: Zeno is a voice and vision-powered IT support agent that resolves common Tier-1 tickets before they ever reach a human.
